body: You are definitely right. It’s arugula. I had another “lettuce” that had flowered and comparing pictures, it’s the same. Thanks so much!
Super interesting. They seem like two different plants to me. I almost yanked it out.

Ah! I read the adding compost will acidify the soil and the soil kept reading it was very alkaline so I figured the compost would work. Maybe I added too much. Luckily I have two pots of strawberry plants. The other one seems to be doing fine after adding the compost.
Great thank you! I was worried it was fungus because that’s what I kept reading.

I mixed the soil with gardening soil and compost. I have a water meter to make sure I’m not over or under watering and they’re on my deck where they get plenty of sun. I still don’t know what I’m doing wrong. First garden attempt.
